Antelope Valley Medical Center
Response to Request to Amend Protected Health Information/Statement of Disagreement
March 30, 2026
Dear Mr. Hernandez,
We have received a Statement of Disagreement submission that requires additional clarification before it may be accepted and incorporated into the medical record. Please review the items outlined below...
- The box indicating 'I do not want to file a Statement of Disagreement' was marked in error.
- Please ensure that the box indicating 'I want to file this Statement of Disagreement' is clearly marked.
